decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the firm's office systems and flexible-workplace direction, this desk line likely meets or stays near aspiration, so available slack supports continued retention.
A chair family is tightly aligned with the firm's established premium furnishing competence, making withdrawal unlikely unless results have clearly fallen below aspiration.

The floor cushions are more niche and peripheral, so they are closer to triggering problemistic search, but their fit with the firm's material and interior-solution capabilities still justifies one more period.

After several years with weaker initial prominence than the other launches, the sofa is the likeliest candidate to sit below aspiration and have its resources redirected to stronger lines and new development.

The high standing table remains a close fit with contemporary office and conference settings, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it absent clear evidence of persistent underperformance.

Although more distant from the legacy range, the rug collection was framed as a flagship strategic direction, so management is likely to tolerate moderate uncertainty and keep it unless outcomes are plainly disappointing.
